title: The May Morning Dew

nodes.title: First sound
nodes.body: Whistle to the mouth. Pads on all six holes. A steady low D. Hold until it sits still.

nodes.title: Staircase
nodes.body: One finger lifts at a time — only the notes the air uses. Hear it, find it, play it back.
nodes.high_d_body: Fingerings you know. Find them on this tube, one lift at a time.

nodes.title: Breath and octave
nodes.body: Same fingering as low D. Soft air keeps the low one. More air finds the octave — then come home.
nodes.high_d_body: The low whistle wants slower air than the small one. Soft first, then find the octave on purpose.

nodes.title: Hedwig's Theme
nodes.body: A tune you already know. Open the letter notes and use the key of D — that is this whistle. The key of C on the same page is for piano, flute, and recorder. Play the opening from those D letters, one note at a time. A high mark is the same holes and more air. The tune stays on that page.

nodes.title: On the breath
nodes.body: A short phrase. The tongue starts the line, then stays off. Let the notes join.

nodes.title: The air, bare
nodes.body: Hear the phrase. See the holes. Play from the start of the chunk.

nodes.title: Cut
nodes.body: On one long note: a finger snaps open and shut, too short to hum, on the pulse.

nodes.title: Tap
nodes.body: A finger below the sounding note flicks shut and open. Pitch dips and returns.

nodes.title: Roll
nodes.body: Cut near the start, tap later. The note itself is still the one you meant.

nodes.title: The May Morning Dew
nodes.body: The same air, with cut, tap, and roll only where marked. Pictures can hide.

source: Teaching setting in D, written for this pack.
